dedupe_keys.name: a unified longitudinal trajectory dataset for automated vehicle

description: A unified longitudinal trajectory dataset for automated vehicle is a data set described in a peer-reviewed Scientific Data article written by Hang Zhou et al. Automated Vehicles (AVs) promise significant advances in transportation. Critical to these improvements is understanding AVs’ longitudinal behavior, relying heavily on real-world trajectory data. Existing open-source trajectory datasets of AV, however, often fall short in refinement, reliability, and completeness, hindering effective performance metrics analysis and model development. Coverage: global; published in 2024. Formats: CSV. The data are held in Figshare and reached through its DOI listed on this page; the paper's Data Records section names it. Size stated by the repository: 2694582804 Bytes. Access is free of charge and open according to the article. The licence is CC0-1.0, taken from DataCite rights of the deposit. Caveats: written from the Scientific Data article metadata (title, abstract, Data Records section) read on 2026-10-01; the data themselves were not opened or downloaded, so their contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related records: none catalogued yet.
